evidence.captureMethod: native Slint software-renderer application --capture with real --actions
evidence.localCopyReady: The parent confirmed copy completion before any image was viewed.
evidence.caseShaDefinition: screenshotSha256 identifies the current C4 case image; stateSha256 additionally binds state-related conclusions. All hashes are transcribed from this run manifest. No C3 image is used as C4 evidence.
evidence.reviewerExecution: Only static file reads, original-image views and this report authoring were performed. No application, test, build, runtime probe, CLI, SSH or Git operation was executed.

scope.comparison: References are exported at 2x and native captures are logical 1x. Reviewers compared matching logical proportions; quoted coordinates and dimensions are approximate.

mechanics.explanation: All thirty selected capture cases passed their mechanical checks. The manifest retains mechanical_success=false because the complete reference/supplemental suite is absent. Mechanical passes do not create manual review credit.

summary.targetedVisualChecks: The C3 issues represented in these captured cases have current-frame visual closure evidence. This does not close an entire canonical group, behavior or unreviewed variant.
summary.tagFlow: All four current short tags appear exactly once, remain readable and have independent outlines. Long-label, suffix, larger-set and multipage stress is not covered.
summary.sourceEmptyState: The Paperwhite empty-preferences sheet has source identity, a truthful empty declaration and a contained Done action.
summary.queueAndJump: The inspected queue frame encloses its pager; the inspected library jump frames have opaque complete surfaces with the top rule above their grids.
summary.settings: Current category/log/power feedback and button/header/dock geometry are restored. Storage is a ready, known-scale case with real recorded values; unknown-state behavior remains unreviewed.
summary.reader: Required splitting/layout/orientation structure is visible. The older harness only opens these panels and does not establish newly implemented business behavior.
summary.conclusion: Continue with the complete matching-source reference and supplemental review. This targeted diagnostic leaves the clean-round streak at zero.
